scoring_justification: The headline is a computed limiting potential from a complex DFT workflow that cannot be recomputed by the checker; compare reported values to paper gold with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference limiting potentials for methanediol reduction pathways on Cu(211)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported values: pathway1_UL = -0.33 V, pathway2_UL = -0.31 V, from Fig. 1 and main text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's description and reference solve.sh; validated against paper's own reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the specific values reported in the paper for the two methanediol reduction pathways on Cu(211). They are not synthesized; they are the exact scientific result the paper claims.

outputs.description: Limiting potentials for methanediol reduction to methanol on Cu(211) via two distinct pathways computed with the CHE model.

output_contract.notes: The checker validates the reported limiting potentials against reference values derived from the paper's reported results.
